status_summary: No EPA action on the five management items was found. The Senate passed S. 2741, the Legacy Mine Cleanup Act of 2025, with an amendment on 2025-11-19; the engrossed text establishes the Office of Mountains, Deserts, and Plains within EPA's solid waste office with site-listing, best-practice and reporting duties, and the bill has been held at the House desk since 2025-11-20. The House companion, H.R. 3713, has been in subcommittee since 2025-06-05. Neither bill addresses five-year reviews by responsible parties, delegations of CERCLA authority, project management training or Lean management, and EPA's Superfund Solutions release of 2026-06-03 does not mention those items either.

timeline.event: H.R. 3713, the Legacy Mine Cleanup Act of 2025, was introduced in the House to establish the Office of Mountains, Deserts, and Plains within EPA; it was referred to a subcommittee on 2025-06-05.

The Senate passed S. 2741, the Legacy Mine Cleanup Act of 2025 (introduced 2025-09-09, reported by Environment and Public Works 2025-10-29), with an amendment by unanimous consent; it was received in the House and held at the desk on 2025-11-20. The engrossed text establishes the Office of Mountains, Deserts, and Plains within EPA.

Federal Register API searches since 2025-01-20 on Mountains, Deserts and Plains (3 EPA Good Samaritan pilot notices), Superfund five-year review (2 unrelated Coast Guard documents), Lean Management System (0), CERCLA delegation limited to EPA (4, unrelated) and, in review, abandoned mine with Superfund limited to EPA (0) found no agency action on the five items. 2. The reginfo.gov Unified Agenda landing page listed no items, so the check is partial, with Federal Register queries as the fallback. 3. A domain-limited search of congress.gov and govinfo.gov found S. 2741 (passed the Senate 2025-11-19, held at the House desk 2025-11-20) and H.R. 3713 (in subcommittee since 2025-06-05); the engrossed Senate text was read on govinfo.gov and establishes the office without addressing the other four items, and neither bill is enacted per BILLSTATUS. 4. EPA's five-year review page does not mention reviews performed by responsible parties; the EPA news release list was blocked by robots rules. 5. A news search returned regional review pages and a trade article only. A trade report of 2025-10-29 (Inside EPA, paywalled) says a merged Office of Superfund and Emergency Management was to launch on 2025-11-02; its effect on the mines office or on delegations is unknown (see c13-29). Delegations of authority and Lean Management System use are internal documents that may not be published, and EPA's delegations manual was not searched. The office already exists administratively since 2020, so codification by statute would be a parallel step rather than the expansion the text asks for. This record covers only items not tracked in c13-28, c13-29 and c13-08.
